entities.summary: Leila Ghandi, nicknamed "The Moroccan Titouan Lamazou" or "Bent Battouta", is a Moroccan photographer and journalist. Leila Ghandi was a painters & sculptors from Casablanca (b. 1980-07-26, Casablanca). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
